title: HECM Queued Draw Requests: Earmark by Channel
content:
Q. Which queued draw requests does Cedarline earmark on a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) line when sizing the draw ceiling?

A. Added to the amounts kept for the draw ceiling: Cedarline earmarks the draw requests already queued on the loan, meaning its draw requests whose request status is submitted.

Q. How much is earmarked?

A. It depends on the channels the queued requests came through:

- when at least one queued draw request came through the servicing portal or a signed written form, the queued request earmark is the full total of every queued draw request, phone requests included;
- when every queued draw request came by phone, the queued request earmark is their total but no more than the plan's phone draw figure — 15000.00 on the HECM Line of Credit, the HECM Modified Tenure Plan and the HECM Modified Term Plan (0.00 on plans with no draws);
- otherwise, with no queued draw request, the earmark is 0.00.

Q. Do processed, declined or withdrawn requests count?

A. No. Only requests whose request status is submitted are queued.

**Hypothetical worked cases (a plan with a 15000.00 phone figure).**

| Queued requests | Earmark |
|---|---|
| portal 6000.00 and phone 9000.00 | 15000.00 |
| phone 9000.00 and phone 8000.00 | 17000.00 limited to 15000.00, that is 15000.00 |
| phone 4000.00 only | 4000.00 |
| signed written 20000.00 only | 20000.00 |
| none | 0.00 |
